name: College Access Program (CAP)
what_you_do: Get free help getting into college. You go to workshops on college, financial aid and job skills, and do an internship you pick to try out a career.
who_can_apply: High school juniors and seniors who attend PAL Teen Centers.
pay_detail: Free to join. The page does not say whether the internships are paid.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Register on PAL's website.
how_to_apply: Register through the link on PAL's Teen Programs page.
notes: CAP meets at PAL's Webster Center in the Bronx. It is built for teens who would be the first in their family to go to college. PAL Teen Centers, for teens 13 to 19, are free and open 3 to 5 evenings a week.
